observations: Mr. Raman matches checkin-patients.png: short white hair, bushy white eyebrows, round wire glasses, prominent ears, long oval face with smile lines, cream half-sleeve shirt with chest pocket. He smiles warmly at Meera.

Hands match production. Raman's right hand (screen-left, lower) grips the curved top of the wooden walking stick, which is cut off by the bottom frame. His left hand rests flat on the counter. Meera has both hands on the keyboard, and the silver bangle is on her right wrist (screen-left).

Meera matches main-cast.png: long side braid over her left shoulder (screen-right) with a teal hair tie, blue block-print kurta, round face, large round eyes, high arched brows, small hoop earrings. She smiles while typing. There is a small dark dot on her right cheek (screen-left, near the eye) that the reference sheet does not have. The cast text lists only a left-cheek dimple. It is minor and present in the pre-edit candidate too. Noted, not blocking.

The reception desktop monitor in the right foreground faces Meera with its back to the reader, so no screen is shown. The wall TV shows teal with one empty white strip. The QR stand by the glass door shows only an abstract block pattern and a teal bar. The vitals monitor shows abstract blocks. There is no text, number or logo anywhere.

Edit check against pre-edit e884a73a: the only change is the two background patients' clothing. The man went from a light green shirt to plain grey and the woman from lilac to dark brown. Both are seen from behind, so they no longer read as Ravi or the nurse. Raman's face, glasses, hands and stick, Meera's face, braid, bangle and hands, the monitor, TV, QR stand, plant and vitals cart are unchanged. The upper-left white wall area for the caption is unchanged.

The speaker face boxes fit the art when scaled into the panel (about 2.197x). Raman's box covers his face at roughly x290-400, y362-503 in panel pixels, and Meera's covers hers at roughly x679-789, y402-547. The caption zone at the upper left (x16, dy16) is plain white wall.

Continuity: this is the first appearance of the QR stand. It is a portrait kiosk on a grey column with an abstract QR and a teal bar. In 03-3 the close-up stand is a grey housing with a teal frame. Palette and construction are similar enough at background scale. See the 04-1 issue for the stand that does not match.
